Streaming platforms live on two curves: engagement (personalization, discovery, retention) and unit economics (encoding, delivery, churn). Both are decision engines — and both run better on governed telemetry, evaluation-driven ML and cost telemetry.

items: Recommendations plateau without governance over objectives (engagement vs. Satisfaction).
View definitions, session metrics and retention measures inconsistent; product decisions wobble.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Conversational AI & Digital Humans, Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems, AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Personalization/discovery, Subscriber lifecycle, Delivery cost management) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — Privacy/consent among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: One governed platform, many GenAI products: retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
Own your models: tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.
Answers with citations, not vibes: permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate.
Multi-objective recommendation with evaluation gates (satisfaction-weighted engagement)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Telecom, Media & Entertainment level this capability reads as: grounded voice agents resolving top intents with telephony integration and escalation context (care cost per contact down 30%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
